subject: prd/existing-repo-onboarding
statement: If the undo step finds a path adoption added modified since adoption (a chained-hook wrapper or an added file the operator edited), then the system shall preserve the modified path, name it, and complete the rest of the removal — never silently delete operator content
intent: the modified path named as preserved; the rest removed
fit_criterion: adopt → edit a chained-hook wrapper → undo preserves-and-names it and removes the rest
